{{Quote|Those are definitely Incom four-jay-fours. We are in for a pasting.|Voort saBinring|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''4j.4 fusial thrust engines''' were a model of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]] manufactured by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] for use aboard [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] space-superiority starfighters.<ref name="EGVV" /> The engine was rated at 300 [[KTU]].<ref name="Databank">{{DB|starship|xwing|X-wing starfighter}}</ref> Some models of X-wing fighters active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] were outfitted with 4j.4 fusial thrust engines in place of the more common [[4L4 fusial thrust engine/Legends|4L4 fusial thrust engine]].<ref name="EGVV" />
